data.title: Bali Residences
data.about:
Bali Residences is a mid-rise residential building in District 3, Jumeirah Village Triangle, Dubai. A collaborative project of Bali Builders & Developers Ltd and Blue Coast, it features studio to 2-bedroom apartments. Two basement levels are dedicated to parking, while the five floors above the ground are for residential purposes.

The design of Bali Residences Dubai by Serene Development includes premium interiors and impeccable finishes. The residences have floor-to-ceiling windows and study rooms. Strategically situated, Bali Residences is mere minutes away from Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and provides swift access to iconic landmarks such as Burj Al Arab and the Mall of the Emirates. Moreover, Bali Residences JVT is surrounded by tranquil green spaces.

location_tile.heading: LOCATION
location_tile.description:
Bali Residences is strategically located just minutes away from Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road. It also provides easy access to famous landmarks such as Burj Al Arab and Mall of the Emirates. Jumeirah Village Triangle (JVT) is a dynamic community that offers a variety of living options to cater to different lifestyles, including spacious villas, stylish townhouses, and modern apartments. Experience the perfect balance of luxury and convenience at Bali Residences in JVT.

  • 10 minutes to City Centre Me'aisem, Dubai Production City
  • 12 minutes to the Jumeirah Islands
  • 13 minutes to The Springs Souk
  • 16 minutes to Dubai Internet City
  • 16 minutes to Circle Mall, JVC
